note: The games PC Manager lists (Games menu, v32+). The app opens only https://365techies.co.uk/games/... and /bournemouth/games/... addresses. Keep sub under 120 characters.

games.title: Solitaire
games.sub: The classic patience, with big clear cards. Four levels, today's deal, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey along the Dorset coast.

games.title: FreeCell
games.sub: Every card face up, so you can plan. Four levels, today's deal, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey through Dorset.

games.title: Spider
games.sub: Build each suit from King to Ace. One suit is easy; two or four for a challenge.

games.title: 365 Invaders
games.sub: Our own 80s arcade shooter, with power-ups, combos and a Mothership boss. A gentle speed for beginners.

games.title: 365 Bat & Ball
games.sub: Knock out the bricks with a bat and ball. 20 levels, exploding bricks, lasers, three balls and two Motherships.

games.title: 365 Eclipse
games.sub: A space shooter: switch between light and dark to soak up bullets, chain your kills and beat three huge bosses.

games.title: Seafront
games.sub: Ride an eFoil, jet ski or RIB along the real Bournemouth seafront. Best on a newer PC.
